connector.name: Asktian
connector.registryDescription: Chinese metaphysics (bazi, qimen, 5-element) as decision-support tools for AI agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.asktian.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the douglasgan account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ASKTIAN_API_KEY
env.description: OPTIONAL. Readings are free and work with no key (public backend, rate-limited to ~300 requests / 15 min). Set a key from https://api.asktian.com for higher rate limits and the premium tian.* reading tier.
